message.reasoning_content: Describe: FP16 asinh with 1e-6 absolute tolerance — very tight for FP16 domain; polynomial degree-9 in local magnitude up to 1.05. Risks: polynomial accuracy near 1.05, sign of zero (x<0 vs +0 handled: -0.0 < 0.0 false in tl? -0.0 < 0.0 is false, so -0 → +absolute_value = asinh(0)=0 fine, signed zeros equivalent). Large magnitude log fine. Subnormals: cast to fp32 fine. Concern: tolerance 1e-6 is absolute over outputs up to ~4.46 (asinh(65504)~11.8); polynomial approximation error ~1e-7? This is likely a known-good libm-style poly (these coefficients look like an asinh rational/poly from Sun fdlibm? actually they resemble the cosh/asinh coefficients). Record update.
